tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[CW structure on $\RP ^\infty $] ↗ ex:real-projective-space-cw 1. ch0:0.5\group CW Complexes

$\RP ^\infty =\bigcup _n\RP ^n$ is a CW complex with one cell in every dimension; it is the space of lines in $\R ^\infty =\bigcup _n\R ^n$. \end{example}
